daas-irab:31-33.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ the i'rab of its like has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle of affirmation (taqrīr), the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted, and lam is a particle of jussive (jazm). ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam. ﴿آياتِي﴾ its noun. ﴿تُتْلى﴾ a passive imperfect verb; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of takun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause lam takun is conjoined to an omitted clause. ﴿فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ its khabar. ﴿مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and idhā is an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb; its nāʾib fāʿil is latent, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِنَّ وَعْدَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَقٌّ﴾ its khabar; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَالسَّاعَةُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and al-sāʿa is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, which works like inna. ﴿رَيْبَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of lā; the clause is the khabar of al-sāʿa. ﴿قُلْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿نَدْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّاعَةُ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause stands in place of the two objects of nadrī. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ negative. [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a shadda (إِنَّ); as a negative particle it is إِنْ.] ﴿نَظُنُّ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ظَنًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is the Ḥijāzī negative mā, which works like laysa. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of mā; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَبَدا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَيِّئاتُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَحاقَ﴾ conjoined to badā. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ fāʿil. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what comes after them. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of kānū.

daas-irab:34-37.t: ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿نَنْساكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause qīla is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كَما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَسِيتُمْ لِقاءَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿يَوْمِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هذا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of yawmikum. ﴿وَمَأْواكُمُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿النَّارُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما﴾ a conjunction, and mā is negative. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿ناصِرِينَ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّكُمُ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and anna and its noun. ﴿اتَّخَذْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿آياتِ﴾ its first object. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُزُواً﴾ its second object; the clause ittakhadhtum is the khabar of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of dhālikum, and the clause dhālikum is resumptive. ﴿وَغَرَّتْكُمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَالْيَوْمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an adverb of time. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُخْرَجُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا﴾ a conjunction, and lā is negative. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَلِلَّهِ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the i'rab is clear. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿الْكِبْرِياءُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to al-samāwāt; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and two khabars; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:1-7.t: ﴿حم﴾ its i'rab has already been given; ﴿تَنْزِيلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by من, and both are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate); ﴿الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ﴾ two adjectives (ṣifa) of the Divine Name; ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb; ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ both attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات; ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ) for emphasis, and آيات is the postponed noun of inna; ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective of آيات, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and the postponed mubtadaʾ is آيات in verse /5/ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the word آيات referred to is in verse 4.]», and both are conjoined to في السموات والأرض; ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to خلقكم; ﴿يَبُثُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿مِنْ دابَّةٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿آياتٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective of آيات; ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective of قوم; ﴿وَاخْتِلافِ﴾ conjoined to خلقكم; ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾ conjoined to الليل; ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to اختلاف; ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ both attached to أنزل; ﴿مِنْ رِزْقٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from من السماء; ﴿فَأَحْيا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿مَوْتِها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وَتَصْرِيفِ﴾ conjoined to اختلاف; ﴿الرِّياحِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿آياتٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective of آيات; ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective of قوم; ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿آياتُ﴾ khabar, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿نَتْلُوها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿فَبِأَيِّ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and بأي are both attached to the verb after them; ﴿حَدِيثٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وَآياتِهِ﴾ conjoined to الله; ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position; ﴿وَيْلٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar; ﴿أَفَّاكٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أَثِيمٍ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:8-11.t: ﴿يَسْمَعُ آياتِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿تُتْلى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, and the clause is a ḥāl; ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿يُصِرُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿مُسْتَكْبِراً﴾ ḥāl; ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and its noun is an omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); ﴿لَمْ يَسْمَعْها﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم, and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of kaʾan, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl; ﴿فَبَشِّرْهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿أَلِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position; ﴿وَ﴾ a resumptive particle; ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverbial conditional that does not make the verb jussive; ﴿عَلِمَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿مِنْ آياتِنا﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿اتَّخَذَها﴾ a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿هُزُواً﴾ its second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar; ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿مُهِينٌ﴾ an adjective of عذاب, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك is resumptive; ﴿مِنْ وَرائِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿جَهَنَّمُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and لا is negative; ﴿يُغْنِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl; ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; ﴿وَلا مَا اتَّخَذُوا﴾ conjoined to ما كسبوا; ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar; ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿هذا هُدىً﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ; ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar; ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of الذين; ﴿مِنْ رِجْزٍ﴾ both attached to عذاب; ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:12-14.t: ﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي﴾ the Divine Name is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive; ﴿سَخَّرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿الْبَحْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿لِتَجْرِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); ﴿الْفُلْكُ﴾ its fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from أن and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb سخر; ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to تجري; ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ both attached to تجري; ﴿وَلِتَبْتَغُوا﴾ conjoined to لتجري; ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and laʿalla and its noun; ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of laʿalla, and the nominal clause لعلكم is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَسَخَّرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ both attached to an omitted verb forming the ṣila of the relative; ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to ما في السموات; ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb; ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ both attached to the omitted fronted khabar of inna; ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ) for emphasis, آيات is the postponed noun of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of آيات; ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective of قوم; ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to يغفروا; ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿يَغْفِرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to a command (jawāb ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause قل is resumptive; ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to يغفروا; ﴿لا﴾ negative; ﴿يَرْجُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿أَيَّامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of cause, and the fāʿil is latent, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يغفروا; ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to يجزي; ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of kāna, and the clause كانوا is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:15-20.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿صالِحاً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿فَلِنَفْسِهِ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the lām is a preposition, and a genitive noun, and both are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, and the implied verbal clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of من; ﴿وَمَنْ أَساءَ فَعَلَيْها﴾ conjoined to من عمل صالحا, and the i'rab is the same; ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿إِلى رَبِّكُمْ﴾ both attached to what follows them; ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and what is sworn by is omitted, and the lām occurs in the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿آتَيْنا بَنِي﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position; ﴿وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ﴾ both conjoined to الكتاب; ﴿وَرَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ﴾ both attached to the verb, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَفَضَّلْناهُمْ﴾ conjoined to رزقناهم; ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿وَآتَيْناهُمْ بَيِّناتٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and بينات is its second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿مِنَ الْأَمْرِ﴾ both attached to بينات; ﴿فَمَا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and ما is negative; ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun); ﴿جاءَهُمُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الْعِلْمُ﴾ fāʿil; ﴿بَغْياً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from ما and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿يَقْضِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the verbal clause is the khabar of inna; ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place; ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿فِيما﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to what follows them, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كانوا. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿جَعَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عَلى شَرِيعَةٍ﴾ both attached to the verb, and they stand in the place of the second object; ﴿مِنَ الْأَمْرِ﴾ both attached to an adjective of شريعة; ﴿فَاتَّبِعْها﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position; ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; ﴿تَتَّبِعْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by لا, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿أَهْواءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿لا﴾ negative; ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila, and the clause لا تتبع is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿لَنْ﴾ a particle making the verb accusative; ﴿يُغْنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause إن is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿عَنْكَ﴾ both attached to يغنوا; ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to يغنوا as well; ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is a particle resembling the verb; ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ its noun; ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿أَوْلِياءُ﴾ its khabar; ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar of inna; ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ; ﴿وَلِيُّ﴾ its khabar; ﴿الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿هذا بَصائِرُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to the verb «[Translator's note: so in the source, although no verb is present; presumably attached to بصائر.]»; ﴿وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾ conjoined; ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ both attached to رحمة; ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective of قوم.

daas-irab:21-23.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive; ﴿اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿أَنْ نَجْعَلَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and أن and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar, stand in place of the two objects of حسب; ﴿كَالَّذِينَ﴾ the kāf is in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of نجعلهم, and الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ conjoined to آمنوا; ﴿سَواءً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿مَحْياهُمْ﴾ the fāʿil of سواء; ﴿وَمَماتُهُمْ﴾ conjoined to محياهم; ﴿ساءَ﴾ an inflexible (jāmid) past verb expressing blame, whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿ما﴾ a complete (tāmma) indefinite noun, in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification); ﴿يَحْكُمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of ما, and the clause ساء is resumptive; ﴿وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّماواتِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات; ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿وَلِتُجْزى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive imperfect verb, accusative by the implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); ﴿كُلُّ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from أن and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to الحق; ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to تجزى; ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لا﴾ negative; ﴿يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl; ﴿أَفَرَأَيْتَ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative, first mafʿūl bihi, and the second mafʿūl bihi is omitted; ﴿اتَّخَذَ إِلهَهُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿هَواهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿وَأَضَلَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil; ﴿عَلى عِلْمٍ﴾ ḥāl, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَخَتَمَ﴾ a past verb conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿عَلى سَمْعِهِ﴾ both attached to ختم; ﴿وَقَلْبِهِ﴾ conjoined to what preceded; ﴿وَجَعَلَ عَلى بَصَرِهِ غِشاوَةً﴾ also conjoined to the ṣila clause; ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; ﴿يَهْدِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the verbal clause is the khabar of من, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi «[Translator's note: so vocalised in the source; as muḍāf ilayhi the word in the verse is اللَّهِ.]»; ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, the fāʾ is resumptive, and لا is negative; ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:24-26.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive; ﴿ما﴾ negative; ﴿هِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿حَياتُنَا﴾ khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿نَمُوتُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿وَنَحْيا﴾ conjoined to نموت, and the clause نموت is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative; ﴿يُهْلِكُنا﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction; ﴿الدَّهْرُ﴾ its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ما is negative; ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿بِذلِكَ﴾ both attached to علم; ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative; ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction; ﴿يَظُنُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an adverbial conditional that does not make the verb jussive; ﴿تُتْلى﴾ a passive imperfect verb; ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿آياتُنا﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾ ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ negative; ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿حُجَّتَهُمْ﴾ its fronted khabar; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction; ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle forming a maṣdar and making the verb accusative; ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) is in the position of the nominative as the postponed noun of kāna; ﴿ائْتُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying; ﴿بِآبائِنا﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿أَنْ﴾ a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive «[Translator's note: so written in the source; the verse has إِنْ.]»; ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ its khabar, and the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause ما كان is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the non-jussive condition of إذا, with no grammatical position; ﴿قُلِ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ; ﴿يُحْيِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying, and the clause قل is resumptive; ﴿ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, operating like inna; ﴿رَيْبَ﴾ its noun; ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar of lā, and the nominal clause is circumstantial; ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lākinna and its noun, and الناس is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿لا﴾ negative; ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of lākinna, and the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:27-30.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an adverb of time; ﴿تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) for يوم; ﴿يَخْسَرُ﴾ an imperfect verb; ﴿الْمُبْطِلُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation «[Translator's note: so in the source.]»; ﴿وَتَرى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿كُلَّ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿جاثِيَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿كُلَّ﴾ mubtadaʾ «[Translator's note: so vocalised in the source; as mubtadaʾ the word in the verse is كُلُّ.]»; ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿تُدْعى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, and the verbal clause is the khabar; ﴿إِلى كِتابِهَا﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿تُجْزَوْنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause اليوم تجزون is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf); ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿هذا كِتابُنا﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; ﴿يَنْطِقُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿كُنَّا﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿نَسْتَنْسِخُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar of كنا, and the clause كنا is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause إنا is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila; ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and أما is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the response to أما, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿رَبُّهُمْ﴾ its fāʿil; ﴿فِي رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb, and the clause is the khabar of الذين; ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); ﴿الْفَوْزُ﴾ khabar; ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is resumptive.
